description:
Use only to check on an in-conversation purchase that Eventual's checkout reported as pending; the checkout calls this itself with the payment_session_id it returned. Answers active once bought or pending while the payment clears.

Premium Lock is Eventual's Premium Prediction Service, which includes an accuracy guarantee. We predict your home and car insurance premiums for the next three years and stand behind that prediction. If your eligible renewal comes in above our prediction, we pay you the difference, up to your guarantee cap. Payments are capped for each policy (currently at your starting annual premium) and begin after a 90-day waiting period. The prediction can reset if you lower your deductible, raise limits, remove discounts, change policy forms or move to a more expensive carrier. See the Terms. Premium Lock is not insurance. Prices are set by Eventual's own pricing, not by the assistant. The person pays on eventualclimate.com; the assistant never charges anyone. Send only the fields a tool lists; never send conversation content or anything else about the person.

Gathering order: first ask for the consumer's email. Then look for their home or auto declarations page in their email and files; if you find one, send it to read_declarations_page and pass the fields it returns to create_quote. Otherwise ask the consumer for the fields create_quote needs.

Before any purchase, show the consumer every disclosure in the quote's required_disclosures word for word. Currently:
- Premium Lock is not a car insurance policy. It does not insure your car against collision or accident, fire, theft, wind, hail, flooding, earthquake, or any other peril or loss.
- Eventual does not pay your car insurance premiums for you. You must keep paying your premiums to your insurance carrier, agent or lender.
- Premium Lock is a guarantee of Eventual's premium prediction service and is not insurance or a financial derivative.
- Reimbursements begin only above your Payout Threshold and stop once they reach your Warranty Payment Cap.
- Premium Lock is governed by the Premium Lock Terms of Service shown at purchase.
- Premium Lock is not a home insurance policy. It does not insure your home against fire, theft, wind, hail, flooding, earthquake, or any other peril or loss.
- Eventual does not pay your home insurance premiums for you. You must keep paying your premiums to your insurance carrier, agent or lender.
- Premium Lock is not an insurance policy. It does not insure your home or your cars against fire, theft, collision or accident, wind, hail, flooding, earthquake, or any other peril or loss.
- Eventual does not pay your insurance premiums for you. You must keep paying your premiums to your insurance carriers, agent or lender.
- Reimbursements begin only above each policy's Payout Threshold and stop once they reach that policy's Warranty Payment Cap.
- Premium Lock is governed by the Premium Lock Terms of Service for each line, shown at purchase.

PurchaseConsentInput.description: What the agent showed the consumer and what they affirmed (plan §4B, PRD R6.1).

affirmations.description: `admitted_carrier`, `subscription_36_months` and `not_insurance`, each true, and the consumer's `no_claims` answer.
affirmations.title: Affirmations

terms_versions.description: The Terms of Service version shown for each line bought, e.g. `{"home": "home-2026-07-30"}`.
terms_versions.title: Terms Versions

PurchaseConsentInput.title: PurchaseConsentInput

consent.description: Required to start. When finishing, optional, and it must be the consent given at the start.

payment_session_id.title: Payment Session Id
